name: clockoli-extension
description: Clockoli private GitHub-backed task time tracking Chrome extension

scripts.test: npm run test:clockoli && npm run test:timeline
scripts.test:timeline: npm run test:all --workspace elastic-timeline-editor && npm run build:timeline && git diff --exit-code -- src/content/elastic-timeline-editor.css src/content/elastic-timeline-editor.js
scripts.check: node scripts/validate-extension.js && node scripts/validate-release-inventory.js && node --check src/background/service-worker.js && node --check src/content/elastic-timeline-editor.js && node --check src/content/github.js && node --check src/options/options.js && node --check src/reports/reports.js && node --check src/tasks/tasks.js
